observations: Photo 0: Front view of a red and yellow motorcycle with a round headlight, black seat, and chrome front fender. The fuel tank has a 'BOXER' logo. The bike is parked on a concrete surface against a brick wall.

Photo 1: Side view showing the full length of the motorcycle. The red fuel tank with yellow accents and 'BOXER' branding is visible. The black seat, rear suspension with red springs, and rear wheel are shown. The bike is parked on a wet concrete surface near a building.

Photo 2: Close-up of the front engine and fuel tank. The 'BOXER' logo is clearly visible on the red tank. The engine is silver, and the front wheel and fork are visible. The bike appears to have some wear and minor scratches on the tank.

The motorcycle has a classic design with a single-cylinder engine, spoked wheels, and a simple frame. The tires appear to be in decent condition, but the paint on the tank is chipped and faded in places.
No visible damage to the frame or wheels, but the seat shows signs of wear and possible water damage. The rear suspension springs are red, which may be a custom or aftermarket part.

Photos of the tires showing tread depth and condition.
